waysStrip.heading: There are many ways to get your MGRM supports — choose WhatsApp chat, phone help, home delivery, express shipping, size guidance, or easy returns:

chooseSupport.q: How do I choose the right brace or support?
chooseSupport.a: Start with the body area you need support for using Shop by Body, or describe your condition in the support form. Our team can recommend certified MGRM products for pain relief, post-surgery recovery, or daily mobility.

findSize.q: How do I find the correct product size?
findSize.a: Check the size chart on each product page and measure as shown in the guide. You can also use the Size Guide option on this page or contact us on WhatsApp — we will help you pick the best fit.

returns.q: What is your return and replacement policy?
returns.a: If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, contact us within 7 days with your order details and photos. Eligible products may be replaced or refunded as per our returns policy.

shipping.q: How long does delivery take in India?
shipping.a: Most orders are dispatched within 1–3 business days. Delivery time depends on your city and pin code — typically 3–7 business days across India. Express options may be available at checkout.

trackOrder.q: Can I track my order after placing it?
trackOrder.a: Yes. Once your order ships, you will receive tracking details by SMS or email. You can also view order status from your account dashboard or contact support with your order ID.

bulkOrders.q: Do you offer bulk orders for hospitals or clinics?
bulkOrders.a: Yes. MGRM supplies hospitals, physiotherapy centres, pharmacies and institutions. Submit a Bulk Inquiry through the support form or email us for pricing and delivery timelines.

productCare.q: How should I clean and care for my support?
productCare.a: Hand-wash with mild soap and lukewarm water unless the product label says otherwise. Air-dry away from direct heat. Do not machine-wash unless specified — this helps maintain elasticity and support.

warranty.q: Are MGRM products covered by warranty?
warranty.a: Genuine MGRM products include a limited warranty against manufacturing defects under normal use. See our Warranty Information page for full terms, or ask support with your product name and purchase date.
